notes.text: The chapter names Layya in several precise discussions, including the blessing after food.
R. Aḥa transmits in Layya’s name in the lamp discussion.
The exact Yerushalmi line explicitly names both parties and their order.
The exact line gives Bisna in Layya’s name on danger.
The passage explicitly names Le’eyy in Liezer’s name about the first figs.
The precise text in the last halakhah names Le’ai in Liezer’s name on separating offerings.
